name: Blast-resistant walls, blast doors and windows
description: Protect personnel and equipment from accidental or intentional explosion by reinforced concrete/steel barriers and rated doors/glazing designed for specified peak reflected pressure, impulse and standoff. Primary source: https://steeldoor.org/sdi-133

specifications.basis: SDI 133-26 lists blast test methods and design criteria: ASTM F2927-21 doors, ASTM F2912-17 glazing, ASTM F1642-17, GSA-TS01-2003, ASCE 2025 3rd edition, PIP STC01018-2014, UFC 4-010-01 2018
specifications.value: ACI 370R-14 / UFC 3-340-02 / ASCE 2025 3rd ed / PIP STC01018

specifications.basis: SDI 133-26 sample criteria: 3 ft x 7 ft door and frame, seated in frame, welded to steel subframe, Category II response, ASTM F2927-21
specifications.value: 4 psi peak reflected pressure, 100 ms duration, 50% rebound

specifications.basis: SDI 133-26 sample DoD blast quote request form referencing UFC 4-010-01 12 Dec 2018
specifications.value: Charge Weight II, 250 ft standoff, Medium level of protection
